metadata.title: Krew Kode
metadata.description: A small crew of designers and developers building websites and web apps people enjoy using.

about.label: (01) About
about.headlineOne: We are a small crew of designers
about.headlineThree: and web apps people enjoy using.
about.principleOneBody: We start with how it should feel, then write the code to match.
about.principleTwoBody: Clean, fast code your team can keep working on after launch.
about.principleThreeBody: Honest timelines and updates you can actually follow.

design.title: UI/UX design
design.description: Interfaces people understand at a glance, from the first sketch to a design system your team can reuse.

web.title: Web apps
web.description: Fast, reliable products that run in the browser: dashboards, portals and full platforms.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.description: iOS and Android apps that feel native and keep working on a bad connection.

desktop.title: Desktop apps
desktop.description: Windows, macOS and Linux software for heavy work that does not fit in a browser tab.

ai.title: AI & automation
ai.description: Chatbots, agents and automations that take repetitive work off your team.

process.title: Discover
process.body: We learn your goals, your users and your constraints.

process.title: Design
process.body: We shape the experience and agree on it with you before any code.

process.title: Build
process.body: We build in short cycles and show progress every week.

process.title: Launch and support
process.body: We ship, measure and keep improving.

design.intro: Good design is the part people never notice, because everything just works. We start with the people using the product and design backwards from there.
included: Handoff files your developers can build from

web.intro: Fast, reliable products that run in the browser, built to keep growing with your business.

mobile.intro: Apps for iOS and Android that feel native, load quickly and keep working on a weak connection.
included: App Store and Google Play publishing

desktop.intro: Software for Windows, macOS and Linux, for work that needs more power than a browser tab can give.
included: Integration with files, devices and hardware

ai.intro: Chatbots, agents and automations that take repetitive work off your team and plug into the tools you already use.
